Computer Science BSc/MEng at University of Manchester

What University of Manchester asks of applicants to Computer Science BSc/MEng for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Manchester courses · Computer Science field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 3 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US High School Diploma from an accredited US school: Manchester typically requires the equivalent of three A-levels plus GCSE English and Mathematics/Science
  • SAT I 1290 or ACT 27 is listed as one way to meet the GCSE-equivalent part (alternatively the High School Diploma with a minimum 3.0 and grade 12 classes at the GCSE grade equivalent)
  • SAT/ACT is not listed as meeting the A-level part — that is met with three AP tests or dual-enrolment/college-level classes in separate subjects, plus the High School Diploma (GPA 3.0)

University-wide guidance only; the course page points to the Department of Computer Science’s country page, which is published for September 2026 entry and lists a High School Diploma plus APs, with no SAT/ACT.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: Information for students from the US · Manchester: Computer Science – Country-specific information
English language
  • IELTS: 6.5 overall, no subskill below 6.5
  • TOEFL iBT: 90 overall, no subskill below 22 (1–6 scale: 4.5 overall and in all subskills)
  • GCSE/IGCSE English Language grade C/4 (IGCSE English as a Second Language: grade 8, CAIE, Oxford AQA or Pearson Edexcel only)
Verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: BSc Computer Science (2027 entry)

Subject prerequisites
  • Required: Mathematics (A* at A-level)
  • Plus at least one of Computer Science, Further Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry or Physics

Mathematics (A*) plus at least one science from Computer Science, Further Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry or Physics — the second subject is a one-of choice the engine cannot hold; no preferred subject is stated.

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement (US High School Graduation Diploma, overall GPA 3.3): grade 5 in AP Calculus BC or Calculus AB (subscore not accepted); grade 5 in AP Physics or Computer Science; grades 5 and 4 in two further AP tests

The department’s country page states these requirements are for September 2026 entry; not yet confirmed for 2027 entry.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: Computer Science – Country-specific information
Other requirements
  • No interview is described; decisions rest on past and predicted performance, enthusiasm for the programme, interpersonal skills and non-academic interests
  • Only one Department of Computer Science course can be held for Year 1 entry — apply to one only
